stop_reason: A cheap static gate failed before execution. Per the frozen stop rule, no current-config preflight, mock rerun, 188-week campaign, full suite, package, native run, tuning, adoption, pin change, threshold change, or retry was started.

evidence: The committed production delta at src/scenario/scenario_runner.ts:3245 changes only the weekly repair input from canonical SID graph edges to operational OSID graph edges.
The repair helper consumes OSID-keyed controller and sector truth, so the operational graph is the correct domain.
The focused real one-week test covers observer and serialized save boundaries, nonempty OSID fronts/sectors, and retained HVO assignments.
Retained RED/GREEN/type/diff receipts and the independent code review are hash-bound in CONFIG.bound.json at their existing scopes.

No nondeterministic API, ordering change, save schema change, coefficient, data, reference, threshold, control, supply, enclave, package, or native-runtime change is introduced by the one-line source delta.
source_test_review.limits: This source/test GO is not campaign acceptance and does not waive the packet findings below.

findings.impact: FINALIZED.json does not describe the current floor-schema config. More broadly, the executable preflight never reads FINALIZED.json or compares CONFIG.bound.json to an external reviewed hash. Because the packet is ignored by Git, clean-HEAD validation cannot detect later config mutation. validateConfig checks only a subset of the frozen config and does not enforce checkpoint_score_semantics, exact scenario, exact save-week list, comparison/baseline paths, retained roots, diagnostic environment, or node.path. The claimed exact frozen input is therefore not fail-closed at launch.
findings.required_correction: Regenerate FINALIZED.json from the final config and make the executed path verify the reviewed CONFIG.bound.json hash (and entry/wrapper hashes or an equivalent immutable manifest) before any campaign work. Validate the complete frozen config contract, including minimum-floor semantics and all exact paths/lists/environment values.

findings.impact: The required graph gate checks sector-to-formation assignment only for assigned_brigade_ids. rear_brigade_ids and reserve_brigade_ids are included only in the opposite formation-to-roster lookup. A stale, nonexistent, or wrong-sector rear/reserve roster member can therefore pass, despite the plan requiring sector roster and formation assignments to be mutually consistent at all four checkpoints. The five-control selftest has no mutation proving these cases fail.
findings.required_correction: Validate every formation ID in assigned_brigade_ids, rear_brigade_ids, and reserve_brigade_ids against formations[id].assignment.sector_id, reject missing formations and duplicate/multi-roster membership as applicable, and add negative controls for rear and reserve mismatches plus malformed or partial sector shapes.

findings.impact: No executed receipt proves the current final config and clarified floor schema. This review intentionally did not create one after the earlier static failures triggered the stop rule.
findings.required_correction: After correcting and refinalizing the packet, run one fresh preserved current-config preflight and the minimal mock controls for the changed schema/binding and graph-roster predicates. Require child/wrapper 0/0, the expected binding count, no simulation execution, and a fresh leaf. Do not reuse or overwrite the superseded attempts.

determinism_review.notes: The source substitution supplies the already-loaded operational graph and adds no randomness, wall-clock state, unstable iteration, or serialization field. Deterministic evidence provenance remains insufficient until the executable launch binds the final config immutably.
